title: Dreamers' Mothers in Action
purpose: In this project, I was tasked to lead and plan improvmments of their business workflows: Event Management System, Community Outreach System and redesign and integrate solution into ther website.
features: Some noteable features from this projects is integrating Eventbrite API and Google Calendar API onto their website to display upcoming dates for the community; Integrated Sender and Zapier into the Wix website to automate newsletter capabilites; and improved interactivity of website sections by adding carousels, videos, and more.

title: Logo Generator
purpose: A collaborative flask application created for IT-390 course at George Mason University. The purpose of this application was to solve for the speed up the brainstorming process of logo creation and mockups. It utilizes OpenAI's DALL-E API to generate these logos.
features: Key features include user input for logo specifications, integration with OpenAI's DALL-E API for image generation, and a user-friendly interface for viewing and downloading generated logos.
results: The tools provided a streamlined process for logo creation, allowing users to quickly generate and iterate on design ideas. It demonstrated the power of AI in creative applications and provided a practical solution for designers.

title: Expense Tracking Application
purpose: The goal was to create a full-stack web application that allows users to track their expenses and visualize spending patterns.
features: Key features include expense categorization, data visualization using Chart.js, responsive UI listing view options, Clerk based authentication/authorization, and searchable modal with multiple filters to find specific expenses or categories.
results: This was a great project to learn about full-stack development, including backend API development, database management, and frontend design. It provided hands-on experience with Next.js, Clerk for authentication, and Chart.js for data visualization. Additionally, it provided a practical solution for personal finance management in tracking Uber-related expenses to reduce cross-checking to prepare for taxes.
